name: DailyFieldWalk
description: End-of-day site-photo workflow for the BIM coordinator: review the day's pending photos, bulk-approve eligible ones, preview the client digest, then push the latest deliverable register to Planscape so the daily 17:00 UTC digest job has fresh content.

(MANUAL - BIM Coordination Center > SITE PHOTOS tab; no runnable command) 2. Refresh review queue from server
(MANUAL - BIM Coordination Center > SITE PHOTOS tab; no runnable command) 3. Audit active photo checklists for this project
(MANUAL - BIM Coordination Center > SITE PHOTOS tab; no runnable command) 4. Bulk-approve pending photos with default caption
(MANUAL - BIM Coordination Center > SITE PHOTOS tab; no runnable command) 5. Preview tonight's client digest
(MANUAL - BIM Coordination Center > SITE PHOTOS tab; no runnable command) 6. Push the latest deliverable register so the digest finds it fresh
(MANUAL - BIM Coordination Center > SITE PHOTOS tab; no runnable command) 7. Done — daily field walk complete
